name: aiwg
description: Reusable project context and specialist workflows for the AI tools you already use. Agents, skills, rules and MCP tools for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and more, plus SDLC workflows, session memory, and Jev decision support that offloads bounded LLM decisions to save tokens.
